title: Stars Spangled Banger
format: one anthem, one genre per episode: an arrangement brief, a 60 to 90 second master, stem set, and a cover spec. genres rotate so no two consecutive episodes share a register

fiction.disclosure: The song is public domain and the arrangement is new. Every episode states the basis: words 1814, tune To Anacreon in Heaven, and the arrangement is not a recording of any existing performance.

guardrails: no political endorsement, no campaign use, no implied statement on any living politician
no parody that mocks the song's meaning or the people who served under it: the joke is the genre, never the anthem
no sampling of a copyrighted recording, and no imitation of a living artist's voice
each episode credits the genre tradition being borrowed rather than presenting an arrangement as rootless
one genre per episode, fully committed: no medley, no ironic halfway house

episode_zero.title: pop alt rock
beats: arrangement brief: key, tempo, drum and guitar register, vocal delivery, and the one production rule that makes it that genre
the build: verse one as a quiet intro, chorus as a wall, the third line of each verse left ragged
the hook: one line repeated one time more than it should be, which is what makes it pop
stems: drums, bass, guitars, vocal, and a room mic printed with the reverb rather than added after
the note: the anthem is public domain, this arrangement is ours, and the credit line names the tradition it borrows from
